levelMatching.method: ITU-R BS.1770 integrated loudness where a render exists
levelMatching.tailPolicy: Keep the same excerpt window and document any rendered tail separately.

monitoring.levelBiasControl: Use synchronized looping and matched playback gain; never ask preference on raw-loudness differences.
monitoring.requiredContext: Document listener, room/headphone path, interface, sample rate, bit depth, playback level, and date before participation.

mushra.reason: This package does not assert the hidden-reference, anchor, training, reproduction, power, or statistical requirements for MUSHRA.

objective: Evaluate target success and preservation on accepted natural-audio excerpts after real-audio condition renders are prepared.

questions.prompt: Did the change do what it was meant to do?
Did the important parts stay intact?
Does it sound natural rather than processed?
Does it make the production more useful or polished?
How engaging or exciting is it?
Which condition would you choose for this task?
How sure are you about your answers?

randomization.algorithm: Python random.Random(seed) shuffle; seed is retained in the operator answer key
randomization.identityDisclosure: Candidate, fixture, dataset, and source names stay outside participant-facing labels.

stimulusPlan.differentDayRepeatPolicy: Repeat the designated hidden duplicate on a separate listening day when possible.
stimulusPlan.renderBoundary: No new audio is generated by this package; the answer key only points to accepted source identities and existing fixture metadata.

title: TrackSmith single-listener formative A/B/C study
